about: ComfyUI pictures for the plates of "Glove, Visor, Rover" (design/junior-plates). Generated only where the decks used generated or third-party pictures. SDXL base 1.0 on an RTX 4060 laptop GPU with 8 GB; this machine needs ComfyUI started with "--fp8_e4m3fn-unet --fp8_e4m3fn-text-enc --cache-none" (fp16 weights ran out of memory), so the seeds below reproduce the pictures with those flags. After generation every picture is graded by ../grade.py with the arguments in "grade" (grey, with the green glow as the only colour) and saved to ../img/<name>.jpg.

postcard.use: plate 2, A postcard from Proxima b (replaces the midterm's generated postcard)
postcard.prompt: wide landscape photograph of a desolate grey alien plain at dusk, in the middle distance a dense field of tall thin black stone spikes jutting from the ground like a warning monument, small patches of softly glowing green fungus on the dark ground between the spikes, a lone small figure in a sealed spacesuit seen from behind, two small domes of a colony far away on the horizon, a dim small sun low in a hazy sky, desaturated, neutral grey, near black, muted, documentary film still, 35mm, quiet

fungus.use: plate 4, the native fungus that glows near danger (replaces the coral stand-in photo)
fungus.prompt: macro photograph of a small cluster of glowing bioluminescent fungus growing in the cracks of dark grey volcanic rock at night, soft green glow is the only colour, the rock is neutral grey and near black, shallow depth of field, scientific documentary photography, muted, restrained, sharp detail, 100mm macro lens
